title: Receiving a REGISTRATION ACCEPT message via non-3GPP access

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message
entities.description: Message received by UE via non-3GPP access that may contain emergency number lists.

entities.name: Local emergency numbers list
entities.description: List of emergency numbers valid in the current country, received via non-3GPP access.

entities.name: Extended local emergency numbers list
entities.description: Extended list of emergency numbers with PLMN-specific validity, received via non-3GPP access.

entities.name: EENLV field
entities.description: Field within Extended emergency number list IE indicating whether the list is valid only in the PLMN from which it was received.

entities.name: Current country determination condition
entities.description: Condition where UE can determine current country and has not been registered/attached via 3GPP access in that country.

entities.name: Non-3GPP access condition
entities.description: Condition where UE is neither registered nor attached over 3GPP access.

entities.name: Different PLMN condition
entities.description: Condition where REGISTRATION ACCEPT is received from a PLMN different from which the stored list was received.

entities.name: Store emergency numbers
entities.description: UE stores local emergency numbers list or extended local emergency numbers list received via non-3GPP access.

entities.name: Replace emergency numbers
entities.description: UE replaces previously stored emergency numbers lists with new lists received via non-3GPP access under specific conditions.

entities.name: Discard extended emergency numbers list
entities.description: UE discards stored extended local emergency numbers list when no new list is received and specific conditions are met.

relations.description: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message may contain local emergency numbers list.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message may contain extended local emergency numbers list.
Extended emergency number list IE contains EENLV field.
Current country determination condition establishes UE storing emergency numbers lists.
Non-3GPP access condition establishes UE replacing stored emergency numbers lists.
Different PLMN condition establishes UE replacing stored emergency numbers lists.
EENLV field value guards the replacement of extended emergency numbers lists.
Non-3GPP access condition establishes UE discarding extended emergency numbers list.
Different PLMN condition establishes UE discarding extended emergency numbers list.
EENLV field value guards the discarding of extended emergency numbers list.
